title: •Beru Lars
caption: •Beru Lars (V)
game_text: Once per turn, if present at a farm and a destiny was just drawn that is within 1 of the destiny of your ‘crop,’ may use 1 Force to place ‘crop’ in Used Pile. Whenever you play Beru Stew or Blue Milk, may draw top card from Reserve Deck.
lore: Wife of Owen Lars and guardian of Luke Skywalker. Quietly lobbied Owen to allow Luke to attend Academy. Maintains Lars’ farm hydroponics labs.
